# has web page

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasWebPage`](gmeow-hasWebPage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasWebPage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/entities`](../../slices/entities.md)

Relates an entity to a web page representing it — a homepage, a profile page, a project site. The structured form of a 'website / URL' field: the page is a first-class [`gmeow:WebPage`](../classes/gmeow-WebPage.md) (documents module) whose IRI is its URL, so it can itself carry a title, language, and rights. Non-functional — an entity may have several pages.
